items.title: Stanley Kay interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: See John played with George Shearing when I was with Patti Page.

ctx.x: So it’s Nancy Wilson. And I know John. See John played with George Shearing when I was with Patti Page. We played the Chicago Theater together. So I know John a long time. John is a good bass player. And so we talked. And I said, “hey John, listen, if the rhythm gets tired you and I will play. You get your bass, I’ll get the drums.” I said, “it’s be like a dirge, like a funeral in New Orleans.” And John told me something funny, John would say, “yeah.” He said, “imagine the rhythm section and we’re out there…
I always feel sorry for them.
